sourceProcedure.name: Ritual of Undeath
sourceProcedure.rangeAndTarget: One eligible corpse within 30 feet or one living ally within 30 feet
sourceProcedure.effect: Ritual of Undeath. Tags: cultist, undead, rite. Choose one mode. Corpse Servant: one humanoid corpse dead no more than 1 minute rises for 3 rounds as a temporary thrall with AC 13, 10 HP, Speed 30 feet and one attack only when you spend your shared companion Bonus Action command using your Cleric technique attack bonus; on hit it deals S d6 necrotic. The thrall disappears at 0 HP or when duration ends and grants no XP, loot, new corpse, Conviction or resurrection target. Death Ward: one living ally is marked for 1 minute; the first time it would die during that duration, it instead remains at 1 HP and counts as both humanoid and undead until the end of its next turn. Neither mode removes Wounds. The Conviction expenditure can vent Dissonance once.

sourceProcedure.effect: Choose exactly ONE Mystery and exactly ONE Curse at Oracle level 1. They are not parallel subclasses that stack. You never gain another Mystery or Curse unless a future explicit retraining or transformation rule says otherwise. Curse limitations are permanent and cannot be removed by ordinary cleansing, curse removal, resurrection or rest.

sourceProcedure.effect: ARCH-STAGE PROGRESSION. Oracle 3: choose one Tier I Revelation from your Mystery and automatically gain Curse Boon I. Oracle 4: separate ASI or eligible feat. Oracle 5: automatically gain Curse Boon II; any Mystery-specific level-5 feature recorded by the registry belongs to the Mystery module below and does not create an additional generic feature here. Oracle 6: choose one Tier II Revelation and gain Mystery Surge. Oracle 8: separate ASI or eligible feat. Oracle 9: gain your Mystery's fixed Tier III Revelation.

sourceProcedure.effect: HERO-STAGE PROGRESSION. Oracle 10: gain Curse Boon III and Grand Revelation Foreshadow. Oracle 11: RC cap reaches 7 and the preserved encounter-start RC floor becomes active. Oracle 12: gain the Mystery-specific Mystic Insight. Oracle 13: preserved registry draft grants a second Tier II Revelation; after each completed short rest choose which of your two Tier II Revelations is Attuned for features that specifically refer to an active Tier II option, though both remain known and usable. Oracle 14: separate ASI or eligible feat. Oracle 15: gain Revelation Mastery and Curse Boon IV. Oracle 16: preserved Prophecy Trigger Mastery. Oracle 17: preserved Grand Revelation Foreshadow upgrade. Oracle 18: Prophetic Surge. Oracle 19: separate ASI or eligible feat. Oracle 20: gain the Mystery's Final Revelation and Curse Boon V.

sourceProcedure.effect: CURSE MANIFESTATION provides a common operational intensification rather than ten different hidden sub-engines. When activated, your Curse becomes visibly or metaphysically dominant for 3 rounds: gain +1 on Revelation attacks and +1 to Revelation save DC, but take -1 AC and -1 on your own saving throws for the duration. Any Curse limitation that can normally be voluntarily suppressed cannot be suppressed during Manifestation.

sourceProcedure.effect: All combat-triggered RC refunds, including Prophecy, damage riders and Curse Boons, share ONE recovered RC per round. Rest recovery, encounter-start floor and explicitly limited Final refills are separate. A free, copied or refunded use cannot recursively trigger another recovery. Apply this global cap even if an individual card says its recovery is separate.

sourceProcedure.name: Curse Manifestation
sourceProcedure.effect: Intensify your chosen Curse. For 3 rounds gain +1 on Revelation attack rolls and +1 to your Revelation save DC. For the same duration take -1 AC and -1 on your own saving throws. Any part of the selected Curse that can normally be voluntarily suppressed cannot be suppressed while Manifestation lasts.

sourceProcedure.name: Oracle's Burden
sourceProcedure.effect: Your selected Curse is recognized as an intrinsic Oracle class condition rather than an ordinary removable curse. Remove Curse, cleansing, resurrection and similar generic effects cannot remove or suspend it. Only a feature that explicitly names your Oracle Curse can suppress, transform or replace one of its effects.

sourceProcedure.name: Soul-Cracked
sourceProcedure.effect: LIMITATIONS: divination that attempts to read your alignment, aura or intent returns inconsistent results unless it specifically overcomes Oracle curses. Once each encounter, before your first damaging Revelation resolves, roll d6: 1 fire, 2 cold, 3 lightning, 4 necrotic, 5 psychic, 6 radiant; that Revelation's damage becomes the rolled type. While subject to a geas, binding oath or magically enforced pact, the first time each turn you knowingly act against its terms you take S psychic damage.

sourceProcedure.name: Marquis's Glimpse
sourceProcedure.effect: For 3 rounds, ranged attack rolls against you automatically miss unless the attacker is adjacent to you or has an effect explicitly ignoring supernatural concealment. Once on each of your turns when a psychic Revelation deals damage, add a second copy of its unmodified rolled damage dice to one target; this copied damage cannot trigger RC recovery, conditions or proc effects. At the start of each enemy's turn within 4 tiles it makes a Wisdom save; on failure it would lose its Action to nameless dread, subject to the Oracle hard-control guard. A creature already hard-denied by you this encounter instead loses its Reaction and has Speed 0 until end of that turn.

sourceProcedure.name: Omen Reader
sourceProcedure.rangeAndTarget: Self; one ally within 5 tiles; one enemy identified at initiative
sourceProcedure.effect: When initiative is rolled, the Director identifies the visible hostile creature with the highest current attack bonus among creatures you can perceive. You and one ally within 5 tiles gain +2 AC against that creature's first attack each round. Once per encounter before that enemy rolls its first attack of a turn, impose -2 on the roll and mark it with star-ash until the end of its next turn; allies gain +1 on attacks against it while marked.
sourceProcedure.prerequisite: Oracle 6; Mystery: Stars; selected Tier II Revelation

sourceProcedure.name: Concord Alignment
sourceProcedure.effect: For 2 rounds allies within 5 tiles gain +1 on attack rolls and advantage on saves against Charm and Fear. Once per turn when an ally within range fails an attack roll or saving throw, use your Reaction to let that ally reroll it and use the new result; only one reroll can be granted per round. During Alignment, Guiding Bolt and Constellation Mark ranges increase by 1 tile. No roll can be rerolled more than once by Oracle features.

sourceProcedure.name: Rewind Wound
sourceProcedure.duration: Healing instantaneous; protection until start of your next turn
sourceProcedure.frequency: At will while RC remains; same damage event can be rewound once
sourceProcedure.effect: Reference the most recent single damage event the target suffered since the start of its previous regular turn and restore HP equal to that event's actual HP damage, maximum Oracle level+M. If that exact event directly imposed one condition with a finite duration, remove that condition if it is still present and is not a Wound, curse, death state or permanent transformation. The ally reduces the first damage it takes before your next turn by 1 and gains +2 initiative for the current round. If the recorded damage had reduced it below half maximum HP, regain 1 RC after resolution, at most once per round. Rewind does not undo attacks, spent resources, movement, deaths of other creatures or proc effects.
sourceProcedure.prerequisite: Oracle 6; Mystery: Time; selected Tier II Revelation

sourceProcedure.name: Paradox Skin
sourceProcedure.rangeAndTarget: Self; one ally within 3 tiles for time-effect interception
sourceProcedure.frequency: Echo avoidance once per round; ally reroll 1/short rest
sourceProcedure.effect: Once per round when an attack would hit you, roll d10; on 1 the attack instead hits a temporal echo and misses. You have advantage on saves against magical aging, Slow and explicitly time-based control. Once per short rest when an ally within 3 tiles fails a save against an aging, Slow or explicitly time-based effect, use your Reaction to let it reroll with +2 and use the new result.

sourceProcedure.effect: At 2 choose one Fighting Style: Defense +1 AC while armored; Dueling +2 damage to first one-handed melee hit on your own turn; Protection Reaction impose disadvantage on one attack against an adjacent ally when using a shield. At 3 Divine Health gives advantage on disease saves, not universal immunity. At 5 Extra Attack makes two attacks when taking the ordinary Attack Action; named attack techniques use their own counts. These three features reconcile preserved main-registry entries; other old level-table extras, including extra level 14 ASI and undefined free slot riders, are not stacked into this draft. ASI/feat at 4/8/12/16/19 follows general advancement once.

sourceProcedure.effect: Restore 1 HP per point spent, maximum class level per activation. sourceProcedure.name: Sanctify Ground
sourceProcedure.cost: 7 RP to start; 1 RP maintenance after the first pulse
sourceProcedure.rangeAndTarget: 15-foot-radius fixed zone centered within 30 feet; up to 3 allies per pulse
sourceProcedure.effect: Resolve the first pulse on activation. On each of your next 2 regular turns you may pay 1 RP and a Bonus Action to produce another pulse. At each pulse choose up to 3 allies in the zone; each may end one of Frightened, Poisoned or Staggered, or immediately repeat one saving throw against a disease or finite-duration curse that normally allows a save. A creature receives at most one cleansing choice per pulse.

sourceProcedure.name: Vengeful Smite
sourceProcedure.cost: Use normal Divine Smite cost: 1 RP for S d6 or 2 RP for (S+1)d8
sourceProcedure.rangeAndTarget: Creature hit by your melee weapon attack
sourceProcedure.duration: Vengeance Mark until end of your next regular turn
sourceProcedure.frequency: One paid Smite total per round, shared with all normal and reactive Smite uses; any redirection uses its shared allowance
sourceProcedure.effect: Choose radiant or necrotic when you Smite; the entire Smite packet uses that type. After damage, apply Vengeance Mark until the end of your next regular turn. If the creature was already marked by you when this Smite began, add S flat damage to the Smite once. Applying a new mark refreshes but never stacks it.

sourceProcedure.name: Judgment Brand
sourceProcedure.rangeAndTarget: One creature you can see within 60 feet
sourceProcedure.effect: Brand the target for 3 rounds. It counts as Vengeance-marked. Your melee attacks against it score critical hits on natural 19-20, but this does not widen further with another 19-20 feature. When you move directly toward the branded target, ignore nonmagical difficult terrain. Once per round when the branded target willingly moves away from you, you may move up to 10 feet toward it as a Reaction without provoking opportunity attacks.

sourceProcedure.name: Final Verdict
sourceProcedure.rangeAndTarget: One creature marked by you within 30 feet and at or below half maximum HP
sourceProcedure.duration: Instantaneous or empowerment until end of your next regular turn
sourceProcedure.effect: The marked target makes a Constitution save, taking 4 S d8 radiant damage on failure or half on success. On failure it also cannot regain HP until the end of its next turn. On success your next Smite against it before the end of your next turn uses maximum damage dice. This bounded damage replaces the source draft’s automatic reduction to 0 HP.

sourceProcedure.cost: 3 RP; optional 1 RP per aura pulse after the first
sourceProcedure.rangeAndTarget: Self; one wielded weapon; hostile undead in your aura
sourceProcedure.effect: Your chosen weapon deals +1d6 fire damage on the first hit you land each turn. At the start of each of your next two turns you may pay 1 RP to repeat this pulse against up to three current aura targets. Each target is affected once per round. If you decline upkeep, the aura pulses end; the weapon buff may continue for the remaining duration.

sourceProcedure.name: Thorn Crown
sourceProcedure.rangeAndTarget: Creature that just imposed a condition on you within 60 feet
sourceProcedure.effect: Trigger after a hostile creature causes you to fail a save and gain a finite-duration condition. The source immediately makes the same type of saving throw against your Oath DC. On failure it suffers the same named condition until the end of its next turn, subject to the universal hard-denial guard. Your original condition is not removed unless another feature removes it. Thorn Crown cannot reflect damage, death, curses, Wounds, resource loss or permanent transformations.

sourceProcedure.name: Roots of Memory
sourceProcedure.rangeAndTarget: Up to 3 enemies within 10 feet of a creature you just damaged with Smite
sourceProcedure.duration: Until end of each target's next turn
sourceProcedure.frequency: At will while RP remains; once per Smite
sourceProcedure.effect: Trigger after your Smite resolves. Each chosen target makes a Strength save. On failure it is Restrained until the end of its next turn. A fey, elemental or creature directly bound to an ancient magical site has disadvantage on this save. If at least one such creature fails, you learn one truthful broad fact about its origin category, such as native plane, elemental affinity, fey court or connection to the local ancient site.

sourceProcedure.name: Primordial Surge
sourceProcedure.rangeAndTarget: Up to 3 chosen creatures in your Oath aura
sourceProcedure.duration: Temporary HP until lost; root until end of target's next turn
sourceProcedure.effect: A selected ally gains temporary HP equal to 2 times your actual Charisma modifier, minimum 2. You may mix allied and hostile targets but can select no more than 3 total creatures.

sourceProcedure.name: Primordial Crown
sourceProcedure.rangeAndTarget: Self and up to 3 chosen creatures in your Oath aura
sourceProcedure.effect: For 3 rounds Thorn Crown can trigger once per round without consuming its short-rest use or paying RP. When your Ancients Smite critical-hit root successfully affects a creature, choose one adjacent hostile creature; it makes the same Strength save and becomes rooted on failure, at most one spread target per critical. A selected allied target has advantage on saves against Charmed. A selected hostile fey or elemental makes a Wisdom save at the start of each turn; on failure it cannot attack allies other than you until the start of its next turn, though it may take other actions. The same creature remains subject to the universal denial cap.

sourceProcedure.name: Linked Ward
sourceProcedure.rangeAndTarget: One willing ally in your Oath aura
sourceProcedure.effect: Mark one willing ally. Once per round when it takes damage, use your Reaction to redirect up to 2 times your actual Charisma modifier, minimum 2, of that damage to yourself. Redirected damage keeps its type and cannot be redirected again. If this redirected damage reduces you to 0 HP, the ally gains temporary HP equal to the amount you actually absorbed, maximum Paladin level+M.

sourceProcedure.rangeAndTarget: Up to 3 enemies in your Oath aura
sourceProcedure.duration: Until end of each target's next turn
sourceProcedure.effect: Each target makes a Strength save. On failure its Speed becomes 0 and it loses its Reaction until the end of its next turn. You gain no stolen Action yourself.

sourceProcedure.name: Mourning Smite
sourceProcedure.cost: Use normal Divine Smite cost: 1 RP for S d6 or 2 RP for (S+1)d8
sourceProcedure.rangeAndTarget: Creature hit by your melee weapon attack
sourceProcedure.duration: Grief Mark until end of target's next turn
sourceProcedure.frequency: One paid Smite total per round, shared with all normal and reactive Smite uses; any redirection uses its shared allowance
sourceProcedure.effect: Choose radiant or necrotic; the entire Smite packet uses that type. If the target personally reduced one of your allies to 0 HP earlier this encounter, add 1d8 damage of the chosen Smite type. Such a target also gains Grief Mark until the end of its next turn, taking -1 on attack rolls. The mark refreshes but does not stack.

sourceProcedure.name: Sorrow's Weight
sourceProcedure.cost: 7 RP to start; 1 RP maintenance after first pulse
sourceProcedure.rangeAndTarget: 20-foot-radius fixed zone centered within 30 feet; up to 3 enemies per pulse
sourceProcedure.effect: Resolve one pulse on activation, then up to two later pulses by paying 1 RP and a Bonus Action on successive turns. At each pulse choose up to 3 enemies in the zone. Living targets make Constitution saves, taking 2d6 necrotic damage and having Speed halved until the start of your next regular turn or spell end, whichever occurs first on failure, or half damage with no slow on success. Undead automatically count as failing the initial save but still make a save on later pulses, preventing passive denial locks.

sourceProcedure.name: Liberating Smite
sourceProcedure.cost: Use normal Divine Smite cost: 1 RP for S d6 or 2 RP for (S+1)d8
sourceProcedure.rangeAndTarget: Creature hit by your melee weapon attack
sourceProcedure.duration: Instantaneous; freedom until end of target's next turn
sourceProcedure.frequency: One paid Smite total per round, shared with all normal and reactive Smite uses; any redirection uses its shared allowance
sourceProcedure.effect: Choose force or radiant; the entire Smite packet uses that type. If the target is currently grappling or restraining another creature, one grapple or restraint it is maintaining ends after damage. If the target itself is Grappled or Restrained, those conditions are suppressed until the end of its next turn, after which a still-valid source may resume them. Against a Director-identified oppressor actively enforcing captivity or coercion in the scene, add S flat damage once.

sourceProcedure.name: Aura of Liberation
sourceProcedure.rangeAndTarget: Up to 3 chosen allies in your Oath aura
sourceProcedure.duration: While conscious and target remains in aura
sourceProcedure.frequency: Choose targets at start of each turn
sourceProcedure.effect: Selected allies gain +1 on saves or checks made to avoid or escape Grappled or Restrained. Once on each selected ally's turn, it may use a Bonus Action to repeat one legal escape check against a grapple or restraint currently affecting it. This grants no automatic success.

sourceProcedure.name: Righteous Quake
sourceProcedure.rangeAndTarget: Up to 3 creatures in a 15-foot burst centered on you; allies in burst
sourceProcedure.effect: End one ordinary Grappled or Restrained effect on each willing ally in the burst. Enemies in the burst make Strength saves, taking 2 S d6 force damage and being pushed 10 feet on failure, or half damage with no push on success. A magical restraint on an ally is suppressed until the end of your next turn unless another spell explicitly dispels it.

sourceProcedure.name: Break Bonds
sourceProcedure.duration: Instantaneous; movement/escape benefit until end of next turn
sourceProcedure.effect: End one non-artifact Grappled or Restrained condition affecting the ally if its source permits magical release. If the restraint was magical, the ally also gains +10 feet Speed and advantage on its next check or save to escape another grapple/restraint before the end of its next turn. This does not dispel unrelated spell effects.

sourceProcedure.name: Shatter Shackles
sourceProcedure.rangeAndTarget: 15-foot-radius burst centered within 30 feet; up to 3 allies
sourceProcedure.effect: Choose up to 3 allies in the area. End each mundane Grappled or Restrained condition affecting them. For a magical restraint or binding effect of rank 3 or lower, end it automatically. For rank 4 or higher, make a Charisma check adding proficiency against DC 10+spell rank; success ends that restraint. Artifact or plot-locked bindings are unaffected unless explicitly susceptible.

sourceProcedure.name: Revolution's Cry
sourceProcedure.rangeAndTarget: Up to 3 allies or Director-identified oppressors in your Oath aura
sourceProcedure.effect: Selected allies gain +10 feet Speed and advantage on saves/checks against Grappled and Restrained for 3 rounds. When a selected hostile oppressor starts its turn in the aura, it makes a Wisdom save; on failure it loses its Reaction until the end of that turn. Save again each round; no full Action denial occurs.

sourceProcedure.name: Unbound Host
sourceProcedure.rangeAndTarget: Up to 3 chosen allies in your Oath aura
sourceProcedure.effect: Selected allies cannot become Grappled or Restrained by non-artifact effects and are immune to magical effects whose sole function is binding them in place. Whenever an affected ally ends an existing grapple or restraint as the spell begins or later breaks free from one resumed after suppression, it gains +10 feet Speed until the end of its next turn.

sourceProcedure.name: Liberty Unbound
sourceProcedure.rangeAndTarget: Allies in your Oath aura; up to 3 hostile oppressors in the aura
sourceProcedure.effect: Immediately end eligible magical Grappled or Restrained effects on allies in your aura as though by Shatter Shackles. Chosen hostile oppressors make Strength saves on activation; on failure they are pushed 10 feet and lose Reactions until the end of their next turn. No creature loses a full Action from this Final.

sourceProcedure.name: Reign of Ashes Aura
sourceProcedure.rangeAndTarget: Up to 3 chosen enemies in your Oath aura
sourceProcedure.duration: While conscious and target remains in aura
sourceProcedure.frequency: Choose targets at start of each turn
sourceProcedure.effect: Selected enemies cannot benefit from newly applied temporary buffs that grant movement increases, advantage on escape checks or immunity to Grappled/Restrained while in the aura. sourceProcedure.effect: Totem Casting is Action 2 RP, duration 3 of your turns, 15 ft aura. Choose Flame, Stone, Frost, Spirit or Renewal. Benefits require an ally/target in the aura, maximum 3 creatures benefiting per pulse/round chosen by you. Flame adds 1 fire to an ally's first direct weapon hit per round; on critical that target Burns 1d4 next turn. Stone reduces damage by 1 and gives enemies-1 to STR checks to shove. Frost: enemy first entering/starting each round makes CON save or Speed-10 ft until end its turn. Spirit: first necrotic/hex damage per target per round adds 1. Renewal: on start and each of next 2 turns with Bonus Action+1 RP maintenance, up to 3 allies regain 2 HP. Thus Renewal total cost 4 RP for 3 pulses; no free healing on entry. All totems share one concentration burden; losing it ends all. Other concentration effects replace them. Non-Renewal auras need no Bonus Action upkeep. Multiple same-name/stat auras do not stack.

sourceProcedure.effect: Overwatch is an automatic Base engine at 1. Bonus Action designate a visible 15 ft square within weapon range until start next regular turn. Once during that interval, spend your Reaction when a perceived enemy enters, moves inside, attacks an ally from, or reveals itself inside the zone. The optional Overwatch card upgrades this engine. At 17 you may move 5 ft without opportunity attacks after its shot, once/round.

sourceProcedure.effect: MATRIX MASTERY MODIFICATIONS. After acquiring Matrix Mastery, each prepared ordinary spell matrix may carry at most one modification chosen during preparation. QUICK SUBSTITUTION: once per short rest, replace one matrix marked Quick Substitution with another spellbook spell of exactly the same rank using a 1-minute ritual instead of the normal 10-minute midday swap; the replacement loses the modification until the next long rest. COMPONENT ENHANCEMENT: when casting a damaging or healing matrix, spend 1 additional RP to add one extra die of the spell's primary damage or healing die to one roll; if the spell has no such die this modification has no effect. MATRIX LINKING: pair two different prepared matrix families during preparation; after legally casting one, the other costs 1 less RP, minimum 1, if cast before the end of your next regular turn, at most once per pair per round. STABILITY REINFORCEMENT: gain +2 on concentration saves caused by damage while maintaining that matrix. A matrix modification never creates another spell cast or proc event.

sourceProcedure.name: Mental Binding
sourceProcedure.effect: Mental Binding. Tags: hero, necromancer, wizard-spell, enchantment, control, concentration. Target WIS save; failure becomes Charmed for at most 3 rounds, repeat save at end each turn and on damage. On its first affected turn only, choose Approach, Retreat, Drop, Kneel or Strike; target uses up to half Speed, one object interaction or one ordinary weapon attack as appropriate, consuming its normal Action only if an attack is made. sourceProcedure.name: Ledger's Command
sourceProcedure.effect: Each target makes a Wisdom save if hostile or unwilling; willing undead may waive it. On failure you command it for 2 rounds. Controlled undead reduce their first damage each round by 1. Once during the command, one controlled expendable undead may intercept a single-target attack against you and be reduced to 0 HP after absorbing it. This feature creates no corpse, loot or RC farm. Eligible targets are nonlegendary undead of challenge rating no greater than half your Oracle level (round down), with Wisdom saves initially and at each turn end. Commanding uses your shared companion Bonus Action; only one commanded undead makes one attack per round, capped at S d8+M damage with no monster multiattack, recharge or spell resources. Commanding a hostile undead to spend its Action consumes its one hard-denial allowance; later control can only deny Reactions and reduce Speed to 0 on a failed save, never command another Action.

sourceProcedure.name: The Spiral Opens
sourceProcedure.rangeAndTarget: Self; one known beneficial Time Revelation or one enemy within 5 tiles
sourceProcedure.effect: For 3 rounds, at the start of each of your regular turns choose ONE temporal option, each usable at most once during this Final. ECHO REVELATION: repeat only the immediate numeric damage, healing, movement or buff component of one beneficial Time Revelation you personally resolved during the previous round, paying 0 RC; this copy is not a new Revelation cast, copies no resource restoration, action grant, hard control, condition trigger, Prophecy Trigger or proc. FORCED ECHO: choose one non-player enemy within 5 tiles and one ordinary weapon attack or non-resource movement action it took during its previous turn. The enemy makes a Wisdom save. On failure, during its next turn it must repeat that action pattern if legally possible, but it chooses all legal targets and paths; it spends no limited resources and cannot be forced to harm itself. A player-controlled creature instead, on a failed save, loses its Reaction and must choose either repeat one ordinary non-resource action type from its prior turn or have Speed reduced to 0 until turn end. Allies retain memory of all temporal echoes. This Final never creates more than one additional full Action for any creature in a round. There are only two options in this Final; after using both once, remaining rounds provide only the printed temporal presence, without another echo. An echoed healing amount also pays 1 RC or consumes an unused per-rest healing use; a temporal copy cannot create an uncosted healing reserve.

On its first affected turn it follows that command in the safest reasonable way using no more than movement and one ordinary Action, then repeats the save at turn end. Dread: on failure it is Frightened of you and cannot willingly approach you, repeating the save at the end of each turn. Either mode ends on a successful repeat save. Player-controlled targets retain target choice, may never be commanded to self-harm, and cannot be forced to change beliefs or permanent allegiance. Spending that Action uses the hard-denial allowance. On later turns the effect only imposes Charmed and, on a failed repeat save, no Reactions and half Speed until the next turn; it cannot command another Action.

On failure it cannot make attacks until the end of its next turn, though it may move, Dodge, Disengage, manipulate objects or use non-attack abilities. After suffering this attack denial once from you in the encounter, later failed saves instead remove its Reaction and reduce Speed by half until the end of its next turn.

bindings.scope: Control-related components only; source costs, eligibility, targets, use caps, condition immunity, source ending and hard-denial guard still apply.
bindings.status: REVIEWED control-scope disposition; not complete-card execution
bindings.historicalDiscussion: Initial qualifying hostile save failure → source-local attack denial, subject to common hard-denial guard. It does not remove movement/Actions generally. After this source-character has already hard-denied that target, a later actual qualifying failed save uses the printed Reaction-loss + half-Speed fallback. Do not invent a save each round; the source only triggers when first entering/being selected under the spell's actual trigger.
bindings.historicalDiscussionAuthority: Historical conference context only. Exact sourceProcedure and operationalGuide with operationalOverrides control; corrected statements are not competing active rules.

sourceProcedure.name: Standing Stone
sourceProcedure.effect: The zone is difficult terrain for enemies and normal terrain for allies you choose when casting. At the start of each hostile fey or elemental's turn in the zone, it makes a Strength save. On failure its Speed is halved until the start of its next turn. It saves again each turn; no creature loses Actions or Reactions solely from Standing Stone.

bindings.scope: Control-related components only; source costs, eligibility, targets, use caps, condition immunity, source ending and hard-denial guard still apply.
bindings.status: REVIEWED control-scope disposition; not complete-card execution
bindings.historicalDiscussion: Each hostile fey/elemental regular-start pulse may apply paladin.standing-stone.slow: half-Speed until its next regular start. No Action/Reaction loss.
bindings.historicalDiscussionAuthority: Historical conference context only. Exact sourceProcedure and operationalGuide with operationalOverrides control; corrected statements are not competing active rules.

sourceProcedure.name: Iron Leash Aura
sourceProcedure.rangeAndTarget: Up to 3 chosen enemies in your Oath aura
sourceProcedure.duration: While conscious and target remains in aura
sourceProcedure.frequency: Choose targets at start of each turn
sourceProcedure.effect: A selected enemy has Speed reduced by 10 feet, minimum 5 feet. The first time each round it willingly moves farther from you, it makes a Strength save; on failure its movement ends after 5 feet of that movement. This does not remove Actions or prevent forced movement.
sourceProcedure.prerequisite: Paladin 3; Oathbreaker — Oath of the Chain

bindings.scope: Control-related components only; source costs, eligibility, targets, use caps, condition immunity, source ending and hard-denial guard still apply.
bindings.status: REVIEWED control-scope disposition; not complete-card execution
bindings.historicalDiscussion: Selected target has paladin.iron-leash-aura.slow: transform min(preControlSpeed, max(5, preControlSpeed-10)). Never raises a creature already below 5. Separate once/round voluntary-away movement rider can end that movement after 5 actual feet on failed STR; grants no free movement.
bindings.historicalDiscussionAuthority: Historical conference context only. Exact sourceProcedure and operationalGuide with operationalOverrides control; corrected statements are not competing active rules.

sourceProcedure.name: Reign of Ashes
sourceProcedure.rangeAndTarget: Up to 3 enemies in your Oath aura
sourceProcedure.duration: Damage instantaneous; ash bonds until end of next turn
sourceProcedure.effect: Each target makes a Dexterity save, taking 2 S d6 fire damage on failure or half on success. A failing target becomes ash-bound until the end of its next turn: Speed is halved and it cannot benefit from Dash or teleportation. It retains its Action and Reaction unless another feature removes them.
sourceProcedure.prerequisite: Paladin 11; Oathbreaker — Oath of Chains Broken

bindings.scope: Control-related components only; source costs, eligibility, targets, use caps, condition immunity, source ending and hard-denial guard still apply.
bindings.status: REVIEWED control-scope disposition; not complete-card execution
bindings.historicalDiscussion: Failure → paladin.reign-of-ashes.ash-bound: half-Speed + no Dash + no voluntary teleport. “Until end of next turn” is unqualified, therefore source next regular-turn end under the combat convention. Not Restrained/Root.
bindings.historicalDiscussionAuthority: Historical conference context only. Exact sourceProcedure and operationalGuide with operationalOverrides control; corrected statements are not competing active rules.
operationalOverrides: Operative its-next-turn wins over summary: target next regular END. Half-Speed/noDash/no willing teleport benefit, including consent to allied transport. Legal involuntary hostile teleport remains source-governed.

sourceProcedure.name: Royal Decree
sourceProcedure.rangeAndTarget: One hearing creature within 30 feet; three selected aura allies
sourceProcedure.duration: Until end of target’s next turn
sourceProcedure.effect: Target makes a Wisdom save. On failure it chooses to kneel Prone or move toward you by the safest route using up to its normal Speed on its next turn. It retains its Action and chooses its targets. No self-harm or hazardous route is required. Three chosen allies in your aura gain +1 on morale checks and saves against Frightened until the end of your next turn.
sourceProcedure.prerequisite: Paladin 5; Oath of the Martyr King

bindings.scope: Control-related components only; source costs, eligibility, targets, use caps, condition immunity, source ending and hard-denial guard still apply.
bindings.status: REVIEWED control-scope disposition; not complete-card execution
bindings.historicalDiscussion: STATE one-turn compulsion, target clock. Target itself chooses Prone-kneel or safe movement toward source; retains Action and target choice. This does not consume the whole-Action hard-denial allowance because it neither removes nor replaces the Action. Ally morale/Frightened-save buff is a separate beneficial source-clock rider.
bindings.historicalDiscussionAuthority: Historical conference context only. Exact sourceProcedure and operationalGuide with operationalOverrides control; corrected statements are not competing active rules.

sourceProcedure.name: Elemental Affinity
sourceProcedure.effect: Choose Fire: first fire technique hit/turn adds 1 damage; Ice: first cold damage target/turn loses 5 ft Speed until end next turn; Air:+5 ft Speed; Earth:+1 on STR/CON saves against forced movement. These are alternatives, not cumulative affinities.

bindings.status: REVIEWED control-scope disposition; not complete-card execution
bindings.historicalDiscussion: If Ice selected, actual positive cold damage to the first target on that owner's turn creates shaman.elemental-affinity.ice-slow: -5 ft, replaced by -10 ft with the already-reviewed Enhanced Elemental Attunement. Same-group refresh/no addition.
bindings.historicalDiscussionAuthority: Historical conference context only. Exact sourceProcedure and operationalGuide with operationalOverrides control; corrected statements are not competing active rules.
operationalOverrides: Ice slow: SOURCE next regular END. Enhanced Attunement replaces5 with10, not another slow.

sourceProcedure.name: Elemental Chorus
sourceProcedure.rangeAndTarget: Four spirits in 10 ft-radius zone within 30 ft
sourceProcedure.effect: Summon a single Chorus package: four visible spirits share HP 4 L, AC 12+PB, immobile. Bonus Action command pulses up to 3 enemies: DEX save S d6 chosen affinity damage half; one failed target Speed-10 ft until end next turn. Four spirits do not make four separate attacks.

bindings.scope: Control-related components only; source costs, eligibility, targets, use caps, condition immunity, source ending and hard-denial guard still apply.
bindings.status: REVIEWED control-scope disposition; not complete-card execution
bindings.historicalDiscussion: Each commanded pulse may choose one failed target to receive shaman.elemental-chorus.slow, -10 ft target-next-turn clock. Four spirits do not create four records.
bindings.historicalDiscussionAuthority: Historical conference context only. Exact sourceProcedure and operationalGuide with operationalOverrides control; corrected statements are not competing active rules.
operationalOverrides: Slow: SOURCE next regular END, correcting earlier discussion.

sourceProcedure.name: Balanced Elements
sourceProcedure.effect: Choose one application: add 1 damage to its next Burn tick OR extend a Speed reduction until end target's following turn. Never extends Stunned, silence, concentration duration or whole-Action denial.

bindings.scope: Control-related components only; source costs, eligibility, targets, use caps, condition immunity, source ending and hard-denial guard still apply.
bindings.status: REVIEWED control-scope disposition; not complete-card execution
bindings.historicalDiscussion: HOOK/modifier. Once/turn choose one eligible owned shaman.elemental-slow record and extend its endpoint to the end of the target's following regular turn. It does not add magnitude or create a second record and cannot extend the explicitly excluded denial/silence/Stunned/concentration effects. Do not infer every Shaman Speed0 effect as “elemental” merely from ownership.
bindings.historicalDiscussionAuthority: Historical conference context only. Exact sourceProcedure and operationalGuide with operationalOverrides control; corrected statements are not competing active rules.
operationalOverrides: Owned explicitly classified elemental control may include legal multiclass sources. No Shaman-class-only restriction. Extend from NOW to target following regular end, max with existing endpoint, capped by governing source/concentration maximum; no recursive deadline addition. Actual elemental membership in guide/metadata.
bindings.modifierScope: Only an owned eligible application with source costs/limits paid; elemental slow and existing eligible Burn procedure remain distinct alternatives. No automated source dispatch.

sourceProcedure.effect: Consume prepared poison without its normal recipe effect; target CON save or Bleed 1d4 next 2 turns, Speed-10 ft and-1 next attack damage. Reapplication refreshes; source stack 3 replaced by one bounded package.

sourceProcedure.name: Crippling Lash
sourceProcedure.effect: Make one weapon attack. If it qualifies for Sneak, CON save or Speed-10 ft and-1 damage on next weapon hit for duration. No extra Sneak packet.

sourceProcedure.name: Brutal Strike
sourceProcedure.rangeAndTarget: One creature within your weapon reach
sourceProcedure.duration: Instantaneous; Stagger until end of target's next turn
sourceProcedure.effect: Brutal Strike. Make one melee weapon attack using its normal ability. On hit add S d6 damage of the weapon's type. The target makes a Constitution save; on failure it is Staggered, taking -1 on attack rolls and -5 feet Speed until the end of its next turn. This is not a full-turn denial.

operationalOverrides: Custom -1 attacks/-5Speed only; not Core Staggered. classification.staggered for named readers/removers. Strongest same-style attack penalty, no addition with Monk version.

sourceProcedure.name: Mutation Overload
sourceProcedure.duration: 2 rounds; backlash until end of following turn
sourceProcedure.effect: Mutation Overload. For 2 rounds, enhance each currently active mutation once: an AC, DR, attack, save or flat-damage bonus increases by 1; a movement or reach bonus increases by 5 feet; or one mutation damage/healing roll gains +1d4. Immunities, target counts, resource generation and action grants cannot be increased. When Overload ends, you suffer -1 on attack rolls and saving throws and -5 feet Speed until the end of your next regular turn. This activation is illegal if +2 Strain would exceed the Strain cap.

completedScopes.name: Positive packet versus numeric damage
completedScopes.rule: Wrathful Brand/when-damaged predicates use resolvedDamage>0; numeric actualDamageDealt is temp absorption plus actual HP packet loss. Divine Judgment positive numeric0 reflects minimum1 and consumes actual turn; resolved0 does neither.
